speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened. To help you, I need to ask: Do these episodes happen every night, or only occasionally?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors)

I understand these episodes occur 1-2 times weekly for two months, where you scream but remain alert and consoled immediately after. To confirm this, can you tell me if you have any memory of what happened during these frightened awakenings?
